verdict.rationale: Terraform's documented `terraform test` framework runs against test-specific, short-lived resources, "preventing any risk to your existing infrastructure or state." Since v1.7.0 it can also mock provider data, so tests can run without real infrastructure. `terraform plan` (with `-json` output) adds a non-mutating preview before any apply, and a community user corroborates that plans make iteration safe. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the test/mock sandbox behaviour, and evidence of first-class environment isolation (e.g. workspaces or separate state for dev vs. prod) beyond module tests.
